thread:
sam (partnerships): Heads-up — Acme SI asked for an architecture review + delivery checklist for their on‑prem private deployment. Go‑live target is next Wed EOD. Need alignment on network, private image, and marketplace listing timeline.

katie (solutions): ok — can we get an ETA from SI on when they finish the infra prechecks? I can schedule the arc review slot.

josh (eng): quick clarifying Qs: is customer running behind NAT-only infra? do we need public egress, or is egress via a proxy?

sam (partnerships): they said proxy egress to corporate outbound, no public IP on the nodes. They will provide proxy credentials.

akshay (infra): big flag: with proxy-only egress we need to confirm our image pull strategy + healthcheck callbacks. If images are private, are we pushing to their internal registry or using our private image tarball?

maria (gpm): partner marketplace listing affects billing flow — if they're going to use Marketplace (Azure), we need marketplace entitlements by the time of cutover. That takes ~5 business days. Is there flexibility on go‑live?

katie (solutions): let's triage: 1) network/ports 2) image delivery 3) certs & KMS 4) observability/rollbacks 5) marketplace/billing. I'll create a checklist and invite SI + infra + eng.

josh (eng): for ports, minimal list: 443 outbound via proxy, 22 for admin (optional), 8443 for runtime metrics, and ephemeral gRPC/TCP for model serving. SI needs to confirm port mappings. Example snippet for their firewall team:

```
# allow outbound to proxy
TCP 443 -> corporate-proxy:443
# allow admin from jumpbox
TCP 22 -> jumpbox.corp.example.com
# internal runtime
TCP 8443 -> internal-runtime.*
```

akshay (infra): also need to know if kernel tuning for hugepages is allowed on their nodes; our kv-cache uses large contiguous memory. Add to checklist.

sam (partnerships): SI replied with config dump, attaching in thread: "proxy only, internal registry allowed, jumpbox ssh via bastion". They want our runbook for a rollback plan.

maria (gpm): noted on marketplace: if they can't wait for marketplace entitlements we can do a manual billing arrangement for first 30 days, but legal needs heads-up. I'll loop legal if we go that route.

katie (solutions): scheduled architecture review tomorrow 11:00 with SI, eng, infra, and legal (optional). Agenda: walkthrough checklist, verify image flow, agree rollback triggers, confirm patch windows.

josh (eng): bringing up two potential implementation escalations: 1) Private image signing — if their registry doesn't support signature verification, we may need to ship signed tarballs and a verification hook. 2) Firewall rules — some customers block ephemeral ports; fallback plan is to route through our sidecar on a static port.

akshay (infra): for signed tarballs, we have an offline-install path. Need SI to confirm storage location and SFTP creds. Also KMS: do they want us to use their KMS (customer-managed) or our tenant-managed envelope keys? If customer-managed, we need HSM/KMS integration checklist.

sam (partnerships): SI asked about scheduling a vendor site visit next week for image transfer and network validation. Who from infra + eng can attend?

akshay (infra): I can attend Tue morning. Will need a short prep doc of what we'll validate.

josh (eng): I can join remotely for the validation steps and do a hands-on via jumpbox for runtime smoke tests.

maria (gpm): I'll draft a short go‑live comms note and alternative billing plan.

katie (solutions): I uploaded the checklist to the shared drive and invited everyone. Link: https://redwood.example/drive/acme-si-onprem-checklist (please don't share externally).

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: integration-tests/acme_si returned failure on model-quantization check (job 4821). See logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821

josh (eng): thanks — I'll look into that failing test now. If quantization profile regresses, we should delay pushing that image until resolved.

sam (partnerships): action items for now: 
- katie: host arch review invite + share checklist (in flight)
- josh: triage CI test + confirm fallback sidecar port plan
- akshay: prepare offline-install and KMS checklist for site visit
- maria: marketplace/billing contingency + legal loop

sam (partnerships): let's reconvene after tomorrow's arch review and update go‑live date if any blockers remain. :thumbsup:
